rows.name:
You know the weird house below us?
There's a toy called TIGER! TIGER!
by the entrance, right?

rows.label: tlk41100124_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I helped myself to a game...
I loved it so much I got completely
absorbed.

rows.label: tlk41100124_04_msg0003
rows.name:
My high score right
now is 18,310 points!

rows.label: tlk41100124_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I wanted to become a botanist, but
maybe I should aim to become a
TIGER! TIGER! pro instead...?
